def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(4)
    ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(4)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Temporary qubits for carries
    t = [ctx.alloc() for _ in range(3)]
    
    # Compute carries using Toffoli gates
    # c1 = a0 & b0
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], t[0])
    # c2 = (a1 & b1) | (a1 & c1) | (b1 & c1)
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], t[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], t[0], t[1])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], t[0], t[1])
    # c3 = (a2 & b2) | (a2 & c2) | (b2 & c2)
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], t[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], t[1], t[2])
    ctx.ccx(b[2], t[1], t[2])
    
    # Sum bits using CNOT and Toffoli
    # s0 = a0 XOR b0
    ctx.cx(b[0], a[0])
    # s1 = a1 XOR b1 XOR c1
    ctx.cx(b[1], a[1])
    ctx.cx(t[0], a[1])
    # s2 = a2 XOR b2 XOR c2
    ctx.cx(b[2], a[2])
    ctx.cx(t[1], a[2])
    # s3 = a3 XOR b3 XOR c3
    ctx.cx(b[3], a[3])
    ctx.cx(t[2], a[3])
    
    # Clean up temporary qubits
    # Uncompute carries
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], t[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], t[1], t[2])
    ctx.ccx(b[2], t[1], t[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], t[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], t[0], t[1])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], t[0], t[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], t[0])
    
    # Free temporaries
    for q in t:
        ctx.free(q)

def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(4); ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(4); ctx.reg("b", b)
    c = ctx.alloc()                 # single carry ancilla, |0>

    def maj(i):
        # (a[i], b[i], c) -> (a^b, b^c, carry_out)
        ctx.cx(b[i], a[i])
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)

    def uma(i):
        # (a^b, b^c, carry_out) -> (sum, b, carry_in)
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.cx(c, a[i])

    for i in range(4):           # forward: propagate carries LSB->MSB
        maj(i)
    for i in range(4 - 1, -1, -1):   # backward: uncompute carries MSB->LSB
        uma(i)

    ctx.free(c)
